import Mathlib

open Polynomial
/--
Prove that a splitting field of \( X^{15} - 2 \) over \( \mathbb{F}_7 \) is generated by a
 primitive \( 45 \)-th root of unity.
-/
theorem exists_isPrimitiveRoot_and_adjoin_eq_top :
    letI : Fact (Nat.Prime 7) := by decide
    ∃ ζ : (X ^ 15 - 2 : (ZMod 7)[X]).SplittingField, IsPrimitiveRoot ζ 45 ∧
    IntermediateField.adjoin (ZMod 7) {ζ} = ⊤ := by
  sorry

import Mathlib

open Polynomial
/--
Prove that a splitting field of \( X^{15} - 2 \) over \( \mathbb{F}_7 \) is generated by a
 primitive \( 45 \)-th root of unity.
-/
theorem exists_isPrimitiveRoot_and_adjoin_eq_top :
    letI : Fact (Nat.Prime 7) := by decide
    ∃ ζ : (X ^ 15 - 2 : (ZMod 7)[X]).SplittingField, IsPrimitiveRoot ζ 45 ∧
    IntermediateField.adjoin (ZMod 7) {ζ} = ⊤ := by
  classical
  intro hF7
  set p : (ZMod 7)[X] := X ^ 15 - 2 with hpdef
  set K := p.SplittingField with hKdef
  have hpC : p = X ^ 15 - C 2 := by simp [hpdef]
  have hp15 : p.natDegree = 15 := by rw [hpC, natDegree_X_pow_sub_C]
  have h7 : (7 : K) = 0 := CharP.cast_eq_zero K 7
  have h2cube : (2 : K) ^ 3 = 1 := by linear_combination h7
  have h2ne : (2 : K) ≠ 1 := by
    intro h
    apply one_ne_zero (α := K)
    linear_combination h
  have h2ne0 : (2 : K) ≠ 0 := by
    intro h; rw [h] at h2cube; norm_num at h2cube
  -- roots of p in K
  have hsplit := SplittingField.splits p
  have hPdeg : (p.map (algebraMap (ZMod 7) K)).natDegree = 15 := by
    rw [natDegree_map, hp15]
  have hcard : (p.map (algebraMap (ZMod 7) K)).roots.card = 15 := by
    rw [splits_iff_card_roots.mp hsplit, hPdeg]
  have hP0 : p.map (algebraMap (ZMod 7) K) ≠ 0 := by
    intro h; rw [h] at hPdeg; simp at hPdeg
  have hsep : (p.map (algebraMap (ZMod 7) K)).Separable := by
    apply Separable.map
    rw [hpC]
    exact separable_X_pow_sub_C (2 : ZMod 7) (by decide) (by decide)
  have hnd := nodup_roots hsep
  have hmem : ∀ r : K, r ∈ (p.map (algebraMap (ZMod 7) K)).roots ↔ r ^ 15 = 2 := by
    intro r
    rw [mem_roots hP0, hpC]
    simp [IsRoot, eval_map, sub_eq_zero]
  obtain ⟨α, hα⟩ : ∃ α, α ∈ (p.map (algebraMap (ZMod 7) K)).roots :=
    Multiset.card_pos_iff_exists_mem.mp (by rw [hcard]; norm_num)
  have hα15 : α ^ 15 = 2 := (hmem α).mp hα
  have hα0 : α ≠ 0 := by
    intro h; apply h2ne0; rw [← hα15, h]; norm_num
  -- an element r of roots with r^3 ≠ α^3
  have hex : ∃ r ∈ (p.map (algebraMap (ZMod 7) K)).roots, r ^ 3 ≠ α ^ 3 := by
    by_contra hcon
    push_neg at hcon
    have hsub : (p.map (algebraMap (ZMod 7) K)).roots ≤ (X ^ 3 - C (α ^ 3) : K[X]).roots := by
      rw [Multiset.le_iff_subset hnd]
      intro r hr
      rw [mem_roots (X_pow_sub_C_ne_zero (by norm_num) _), IsRoot, eval_sub, eval_pow, eval_X,
        eval_C, sub_eq_zero]
      exact hcon r hr
    have h1 := Multiset.card_le_card hsub
    have h3 := card_roots' (X ^ 3 - C (α ^ 3) : K[X])
    rw [natDegree_X_pow_sub_C] at h3
    rw [hcard] at h1
    omega
  obtain ⟨r, hr, hr3⟩ := hex
  have hr15 : r ^ 15 = 2 := (hmem r).mp hr
  -- order 5 element
  set y : K := r ^ 3 * (α ^ 3)⁻¹ with hydef
  have hy5 : y ^ 5 = 1 := by
    have e : y ^ 5 * α ^ 15 = 1 * α ^ 15 := by
      rw [hα15, one_mul, hydef]
      field_simp
      rw [← hr15]
      ring
    exact mul_right_cancel₀ (pow_ne_zero 15 hα0) e
  have hy1 : y ≠ 1 := by
    intro h
    exact hr3 ((mul_inv_eq_one₀ (pow_ne_zero 3 hα0)).mp h)
  haveI : Fact (Nat.Prime 5) := ⟨by norm_num⟩
  have hy_ord : orderOf y = 5 := orderOf_eq_prime hy5 hy1
  -- order 9 element
  have hβ9 : (α ^ 5) ^ 9 = 1 := by
    rw [← pow_mul, show 5 * 9 = 15 * 3 by norm_num, pow_mul, hα15, h2cube]
  have hβ3 : (α ^ 5) ^ 3 ≠ 1 := by
    rw [← pow_mul, show 5 * 3 = 15 by norm_num, hα15]
    exact h2ne
